user.title: Connect ORVIBO Cloud
user.description: Sign in with the account used by HomeMate or ZhiJia365. Choose the server that contains your HomeMate devices. For international accounts try homemate.orvibo.com. If devices are missing, change the server and select the devices again.

family.title: Select family
family.description: Choose the family this integration should use.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: Only checked devices will be added to Home Assistant.

area.title: Assign device area
area.description: Choose an area for {device} ({position} of {total}). The ORVIBO room is {room}.

init.title: Cloud server and diagnostics
init.description: Choose the server that contains your HomeMate devices. For international accounts try homemate.orvibo.com. If devices are missing, change the server and select the devices again. Capture unsolicited cloud packets in the Home Assistant log. Credentials and identifiers are redacted. Enable this only while diagnosing a device, then disable it.
